name: holdfast
title: Holdfast
description: Runs long multi-unit agent work so an interruption costs almost nothing. Partitions the job into independent units, makes each worker write its output to disk before reporting, and keeps a cold-resumable state file so a fresh session picks up where the last one died.
author: André Almeida

network_egress.reason: No component fetches anything from the network. State lives entirely in local files (STATE.json, per-unit markdown, HANDOFF.md). No dependency on any external API or service.

subprocess.reason: The workflow instructs the agent to run scripts/holdfast-init.sh, scripts/holdfast-status.sh and scripts/holdfast-collect.py via the shell. All three operate strictly on the local filesystem: they create directories, read and write STATE.json and unit files, and print a summary. None of them reach the network or call another program.

dependency_install.reason: Requires only a filesystem, a shell, and Python 3 standard library (glob, json, os, re, sys, datetime). No third-party package, no SDK. Stated as a deliberate design constraint in README.md.
